cause: An SSH connection created while the Direct policy is empty has no inbound PF state. A subsequent protected closure blocks its replies; the SYN-only inbound rule cannot create state from its already-established packets. The identical transition preserves a protected-origin inbound state and its replies.
evidence_scope: Exact socket tuple and PF state snapshots, authenticated READY, server-generated echo timestamp, client receipt timing, confirmed checking/closed policy, unchanged en0 route, and paired protected-origin control. No production or PF/SSH policy edits.
capture_limits: Host bridge capture unavailable: BPF is root-only and noninteractive sudo unavailable; host permissions were not changed.

Guest pktap PCAPs were retained without kernel drops, but192-byte snaplen truncated TCP headers after pktap metadata. They do not independently establish tuple packet timing. No missing-packet claim is made.

proposal.status: Not implemented; requires separate design approval.
proposal.preferred_option_to_evaluate: While the engine remains installed in ordinary Direct, retain only SYN-created inbound TCP state tracking with no Mimo outbound restrictions. Stop engine/uninstall must still remove all Mimo rules. This changes the current empty-Direct-policy contract and must be explicit in design, status and cleanup tests.
proposal.alternative: Evaluate narrowly authenticated existing inbound-flow preservation at the Direct-to-protected boundary. It must prove original server direction and exact tuple ownership, join closure safely and expire obsolete entries; avoid arbitrary packet-based midstream adoption.
proposal.rejected_shortcut: Do not replace flags S/SA with blanket flags any: replies to old outbound connections could be misclassified as new inbound permission and reopen egress.
future_validation: Direct-origin SSH/HTTP connections across approved and rejected protected transitions
Closed-policy native TCP/UDP and public ping/ping6 still fail closed
Ordinary Direct and Stop engine/uninstall retain their documented distinct cleanup contracts

remaining_matrix_decision: Continue remaining authorized runtime runs on frozen4263 without changing or waiving the known failure. New or different failure still stops execution.
